generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The tenderer shall furnish last five years Amount Rs.5.08 Lakhs financial turnover, profit and loss account statement i.e., from 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 from the authorized C.A. (Achieved in at least one financial year a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) (usually not less than the estimated annual payments under this contract)) With UDIN No

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Contractors should be registered as KPWD Class IV & above Civil Contractor
Assessed Tender Capacity shall be more than the Tendered Amount Rs.5.08 Lakhs

itemList.description: Clearing  &  grubbing  road  land  including  vegetation,  bushes, shrubs, saplings by using weed cutter / minor equipment. ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work

Maintenance of Earth Shoulder (stripping excess soil) - Stripping excess soil from the shoulder surface to achieve the approved level and compacting with plate compactor. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003 ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work

Patching of Potholes - Patching of Shallow Potholes using SDBC Gr II 25 mm thick - Patching  of  shallow  potholes  on  asphalt  surfaces  by  using Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete 25mm thickness. The Cost is inclusive of removing the failed materials & cleaning on the road surface, preparation of potholes to the required standards sizes before patching them and application of tack coat at 0.20 kg/ m2 over the asphalt surface including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification. ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work

Patching of Potholes - Patching of Deep Potholes using WBM Gr l & SDBC Gr lI 25 mm thick: Patching of Deep Potholes 75mm thick by restoring the Granular Base  course  using  material  confirming  to  WBM  Grade  -I  with 1ype  Sereenings  standards  wherever  necessary  by  manual means  including  trimming  the  pothole  to  the  required  shape and size, cleaning the pothole, applying Prime Coat (SS1) at 0.70 kg per m2 over the WBM surface and covering the surface with SDBC 25mm thick including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification. ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work
